avis.titre: Finally an Overnight Mask I can use
avis.texte: I spent months searching for an overnight mask that wouldn't clog my pores and was also approved by the acne app I use. I had previously tried the Byoma one, but it didn't do much for my skin. This mask, however, completely exceeded my expectations. After using it, my skin feels incredibly hydrated and looks noticeably more glowy in the morning. It gives that healthy, refreshed look without feeling heavy or causing breakouts, which is exactly what I was hoping for. The application is also super easy, and it fits perfectly into my nighttime routine. I'm honestly so happy I found this product and will definitely keep using it. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a hydrating overnight mask that's gentle on acne-prone skin!
